verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions custom report building or filtering and grouping by class, location, tag or tracking-category dimensions. The only reporting-related items are about customizable performance dashboards and KPI analysis, which is a related feature rather than dimension-based custom reports. The axis clearly applies to accounting software, so the lack of evidence makes this none.
